newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linotype shareholders to get 44.04 marks.
newsitem.headline: Linotype shareholders to get 44.04 marks.

text.p: The management boards of Linotype-Hell AG and its parent company Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG have agreed that Heidelberger will pay 44.04 marks for each Linotype share it does not already own, Linotype said on Tuesday.
That means outstanding Linotype shareholders will receive two Heidelberger shares for evey five Linotype shares, Linotype, which makes high resolution laser image setters, said in a statement.

The exchange ratio is based on an audit of the two companies by accountancy firm KPMG which values the Heidelberger group at 5.5 billion marks and Linotype-Hell at 105 million marks, the statement said.
It added that the supervisory boards of both companies approved the transaction on June 30. It has yet to ratified by the companies' shareholders at their respective annual shareholder meetings.
Heidelberger has owned 79 percent of Linotype since last September.
Heidelberger Druck is a subsidiary of the RWE group.
